title: Eventual agreement of local ideal-power maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\iota:\mathcal I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $\mathcal I$ quasi-coherent and finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Put $P_n=\mathcal I^n$ and $j_n:P_n\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. Let $\mathcal F$ be quasi-coherent. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open with $x\in U$ iff $\iota_x$ is surjective, and fix $1_n\in P_n(U)$ with $j_n(1_n)=1$ and $r_{nm}:P_m\to P_n$ for $n\le m$ with $j_nr_{nm}=j_m$. Let $V,V'$ be opens with quasi-compact intersection [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix $n$ and morphisms $\alpha:P_n|_V\to\mathcal F|_V$ and $\beta:P_n|_{V'}\to\mathcal F|_{V'}$. Suppose for every open $W\subseteq U\cap V\cap V'$ their evaluations on $1_n|_W$ agree. Then for some $m\ge n$, on every open $W\subseteq V\cap V'$, $\alpha_W(r_{nm,W}(-))=\beta_W(r_{nm,W}(-))$.

source.place: Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), proof; Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof. Source text read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM.

proof.text: Restrict alpha and beta to T=V intersect V' using overMap, and subtract to obtain phi:P_n|_T -> F|_T. The evaluation hypothesis says that phi_W(one_n|_W)=0 whenever W lies in U intersect T. Cover T by finitely many affine opens, using only compactness of T, not quasi-separatedness of X.

On an affine member A of the cover put J=image(I(A)->O_X(A)). Finite type gives finite sections of I, hence J is finitely generated. Recursive multiplication-range formulas show image(P_n(A)->O_X(A))=J^n, including n=0; injectivity of that map and finite generation of J^n make P_n(A) finite. For f in J, the stalk multiplication theorem identifies its germ with the image of a section of I; if the germ is a unit then the ideal stalk map is surjective. Consequently D(f) lies in U. On D(f) the restricted one_n has image 1 under the injective power inclusion, so every section s equals j_n(s) times one_n; linearity and the evaluation hypothesis make phi zero there.

Let Q be the finite section image of phi on A. For each f in J every element of Q restricts to zero on D(f), hence is killed by some power of f by basic-open localization. Thus Q localized away from f is zero. Mathlib's localization/support equality and support=V(annihilator) give J contained in radical(annihilator(Q)). Finite generation of J gives k with J^k contained in annihilator(Q). The injective power inclusion identifies J^k P_n(A) with J^(n+k), so hr puts the image of r_(n,n+k) on sections inside J^k P_n(A), which phi kills. This argument also covers the zero ideal, zero ring, and n=0.

The higher power P_(n+k) is quasi-coherent. Clear denominators on each basic open of A: a power of its defining section times any section comes from A. Naturality and linearity make the restricted composite zero after multiplication by this unit, hence zero. Basic opens cover every subopen of A, and Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' gives zero on all of them.

Take m to be the maximum of n and all finite affine vanishing degrees (the empty cover gives m=n). Monicity of j_n and hr give r_(k,m) followed by r_(n,k)=r_(n,m), so every local vanishing persists at m. On any W contained in T, the opens W intersect A cover W; naturality restricts the composite to the already zero local composites. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' proves it zero on W. Distribute composition over the difference alpha-beta and apply sub_eq_zero to obtain the required equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01PM (injectivity) and 01PQ (finite affine cover), read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ. theorem ideal_power_local_maps_eventually_agree
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (r : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m →
      ((idealSheafPower ι m).1 ⟶ (idealSheafPower ι n).1))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (hr : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      r n m h ≫ (idealSheafPower ι n).2 = (idealSheafPower ι m).2)
    (V V' : X.Opens) (hcompact : IsCompact ((V : Set X) ∩ (V' : Set X)))
    (n : ℕ)
    (α : ((idealSheafPower ι n).1).over V ⟶ F.over V)
    (β : ((idealSheafPower ι n).1).over V' ⟶ F.over V')
    (heval : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) (hWV' : W ≤ V'),
      α.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV)))
          (((idealSheafPower ι n).1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (one n)) =
        β.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV')))
          (((idealSheafPower ι n).1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (one n))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V) (hWV' : W ≤ V'),
        (r n m h).val.app (op W) ≫ α.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV))) =
          (r n m h).val.app (op W) ≫ β.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV')))
